The Decision Phase accepts training code only, no weights, so the organizers' environment has no zip either.  This file records the identity as numbers and hashes: name, zip md5, the four accuracy anchors, the T2 ONLINE knob dict, the repo-relative template path, and every shipped artifact's md5.  Regenerate with --dump-anchors whenever LIVE_CARD moves, and commit it in the same edit.
